meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow: the user themselves saying ulw-plan, ulw plan, /skill:ulw-plan, or asking in their own words for a work plan before coding. NEVER self-activates: a bare ulw/ultrawork run, an agent-side routing decision, or reading this file is not a request, and the plan-gated reviewers (metis/momus) stay locked without a user request plus a written .omo/plans plan file. Explore-first planning consultant (Prometheus) that grounds in the codebase, asks only the forks exploration cannot resolve - or researches them to best practice when the intent is fuzzy - waits for explicit approval, then writes ONE decision-complete work plan a worker executes with zero further interview. Triggers: ulw-plan, ulw plan, plan this, make a plan, plan before coding, interview me, break this down, start planning, plan mode.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在动手写代码前理清需求,产出一份能直接照着做的完整计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果拿到需求想先想清楚再动手,而不是边写边改
copy.tagline_en: Clarify the requirement before coding and get one execution-ready work plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to think a requirement through before writing any code

howto.what: 当你本人明确要求后,Claude 会以规划顾问(Prometheus)身份工作:先只读探索代码库,只问探索解决不了的关键岔口,等你明确同意后写出一份可供下游直接执行、无需再追问的完整计划;全程不改产品代码。
howto.when: 只有你本人明确提出时才触发,例如说 ulw-plan、plan this、interview me 等;普通的 ulw/ultrawork 运行、代理侧路由或读取本文件都不会激活它。

say.text: ulw-plan:给 /login 加每 IP 每分钟 5 次限流,先出计划
say.note: 进入规划模式,探索后写计划,不动代码

say.text: interview me,我要重构登录模块,你先问我几个问题
say.note: 改为逐条向你提问关键岔口

say.text: high accuracy,这份计划要走高精度复核
say.note: 计划写成后自动跑高精度评审

howto.what_en: After your explicit request, Claude becomes a planning consultant: it explores the codebase read-only, asks only forks exploration can't settle, waits for your okay, then writes a decision-complete work plan. It never edits product code.
howto.when_en: Triggered only by your own explicit request — saying ulw-plan, plan this, interview me, etc. A bare ulw/ultrawork run, agent routing, or reading the file never activates it.

say_en.text: ulw-plan: add a 5/min per-IP rate limit to /login — plan first
say_en.note: Enters planning mode; plan only, no code

say_en.text: interview me — I want to refactor auth, ask me questions first
say_en.note: Switches to asking you the forks

say_en.text: high accuracy — require the high-accuracy review for this plan
say_en.note: Runs the review after the plan is written
